Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation

Quick Estimates of Index of Industrial Production and use-based Index for the Month of January, 2021 (Base 2011-12=100)

Posted On: 12 MAR 2021 5:30PM by PIB Delhi

The Quick Estimates of Index of Industrial Production (IIP) are released on 12th of every month (or previous working day if 12th is a holiday) with a six weeks lag and compiled with data received from source agencies, which in turn receive the data from the producing factories/ establishments.

2.        For the month of January 2021, the Quick Estimates of Index of Industrial Production (IIP)with base 2011-12 stands at 135.2. The Indices of Industrial Production for the Mining, Manufacturing and Electricity sectors for the month of January 2021 stand at 119.7, 135.1 and 164.2 respectively. These Quick Estimates will undergo revision in subsequent releases as per the revision policy of IIP.

3.        As per Use-based classification, the indices stand at 133.7 for Primary Goods, 92.6 for Capital Goods, 147.6 for Intermediate Goods and 147.1 for Infrastructure/ Construction Goods for the month of January 2021.  Further, the indices for Consumer durables and Consumer non-durables stand at 123.7 and 147.5 respectively for the month of January 2021.

4.        Details of Quick Estimates of the Index of Industrial Production for the month of January 2021at Sectoral, 2-digit level of National Industrial Classification (NIC-2008) and byUse-based classification are given at Statements I, II and III respectively. Also, for users to appreciate the changes in the industrial sector, Statement IV provides month-wise indices since April 2020, by industry groups (as per 2-digit level of NIC-2008) and sectors.

5.        Along with the Quick Estimates of IIP for the month of January 2021, the indices for December 2020 have undergone the first revision and those for October 2020 have undergone the final revision in the light of the updated data received from the source agencies. The Quick Estimates for January 2021, the first revision for December 2020 and the final revision for October 2020 have been compiled at weighted response rates of 89 percent, 93 percent and 94 percent respectively.

6.        Release of the Index for February 2021 will be on Monday, 12thApril 2021.
